crossRefs.note: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are…
When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.
The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all…
who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for the arbiter in the gate, and who deprive the innocent…
For I have heard the defaming of many, “Terror on every side! Denounce, and we will denounce him!” say all my familiar…
They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.
So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”
Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said…
They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out…
lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so…
Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him…
and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses…

parallels.note: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

translations.web: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.
translations.bsb: Looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, the scribes and Pharisees were watching Him closely to see if He would heal on the Sabbath.
translations.kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
translations.asv: And the scribes and the Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath; that they might find how to accuse him.
